title: LearnRequest
description:
`POST /learn`'s body (fork `server-context.cpp`): one optimizer step on a loaded (shadow) adapter, on a reply, in the slot that served it. The reply is given as a conversation whose last message is the assistant's (`messages`), as token ids after a prefix (`reply_tokens` + `n_prefix`), or as text after a prefix (`reply` + `n_prefix`).

The core has no caller yet: the in-place dream stage (ONE-RESIDENT-MODEL §8.1, S4) is the first, and its open fork items (a per-mind shadow, learning a past example in a scratch slot, a duty budget on the wire, a snapshot) are tracked on MIND-DATAFLOW-OVERHAUL row 6.

anyOf.description: at least two messages, the last one the assistant's; rendered with the chat template
